Priyom — did an initial sweep over the pools. Summary:

- Pool west-us-g-2 has 12 A100-32 slots free across 3 nodes; contiguous placement for 8 slots is feasible but will reduce burst capacity for 2026-09-10 -> 2026-10-15 based on current forecasts.
- Pool west-us-g-1 is lightly loaded but only has smaller GPUs; not a match unless we mix instance classes (not preferred).

Recommendation: place a 30-day soft hold on pool west-us-g-2 for 8 slots with a contingency tag 'COD-4321-softhold' that expires 2026-09-30 unless a PO/confirmative action is received. If CodaAI signs a 12mo commit, we can convert and do a relocation/affinity change to guarantee placement.

Notes on steps & lead times:
- Soft hold: Ops can mark inventory and remove slots from general allocation within 1 business day; this is reversible.
- Hard allocation (commit): converting to a 12mo reserved resource requires coordination with scheduler and possibly moving workloads; expect a 7–10 business day window for guaranteed relocation to preserve contiguous placement.
- Billing: soft hold carries no charge; once moved to committed state billing proration will start from the hard allocation date.

I'll prepare the prehold_runbook with exact scheduler commands and the minimal approvals required. Attaching the runbook snippet to the thread.

Marissa Cole
